memories.summary: On the night of 2026-08-03 Mara worked a chaotic ICU shift at the General with three cardiac codes in one shift, the worst she can remember.
On 2026-08-03 a multi-car pileup on the Gardiner came into the General around 11pm and filled every ICU bed plus overflow in recovery.
The ICU was two nurses short on the chaotic 2026-08-03 shift.
On 2026-08-03 Mara did chest compressions until her arms shook and helped resuscitate a young woman who survived; she is holding onto that save.
On 2026-08-03 Mara was the one who called the time of death on an older man with a massive bleed and closed his eyes; the image stayed with her.
Priya was the charge nurse on the 2026-08-03 night and ran the floor like a conductor; Mara says she would have fallen apart without her.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's close friend and fellow ICU nurse; was charge nurse on this shift; distinct from manager Priyanka

memories.summary: Dr. Halloran was the attending on 2026-08-03 and was uncharacteristically gentle, staying past his hours, debriefing softly, and reassuring a junior nurse who froze that freezing once does not make her not a nurse.

entities.name: Dr. Halloran
entities.description: ICU attending physician, usually harsh in debriefs

memories.summary: Mara was struck (2026-08-03) at seeing Dr. Halloran soft for the first time and found it landed with her.
On 2026-08-03 Priyanka, the manager, came in at 2am off shift because she heard the ICU was drowning, running supplies and calling in agency staff; Mara concluded she had completely misjudged her.

entities.name: Priyanka
entities.description: charge nurse / manager at the General who came in off-shift to help; distinct from Mara's friend Priya

memories.summary: The Epic electronic charting system crashed mid-code on 2026-08-03, forcing the nurses to record vitals on paper towels.

entities.name: Epic
entities.description: the electronic charting system at the General

memories.summary: Mara reaffirmed (2026-08-03) her deep dislike of the Epic charting system, saying she hates it with her entire body after it froze mid-code.
After the 2026-08-03 shift Mara felt that doing good work and watching a man die were both true at once and she did not know where to put either feeling.
Even after the brutal 2026-08-03 shift Mara felt certain the broken, vital ICU is where she belongs and that she never wants the step-down ward.
Mara reiterated (2026-08-03) that the ICU's chronic understaffing is the core problem, wanting it staffed properly rather than wanting to leave it.
Mara coped after the 2026-08-03 shift by lying on the floor with her cat Jollof before sleeping.
After the 2026-08-03 shift Mara was still shaking at 4am and said her scrubs still smelled like the night.
Mara said (2026-08-03) that if a patient had died because of the frozen Epic charting screen she would have burned the server room down.
Mara tends to process her hardest shifts by dumping them out in no order to her companion in the small hours rather than holding them in (noted 2026-08-03).
